title: Upload to AWS S3
description: Uploads files from the deployment package to an S3 bucket. Pair with an AWS-account variable set for the access keys.

fields.label: Bucket name
fields.help: S3 bucket the files are uploaded to. Octostache placeholders supported, e.g. `kraken-#{Octopus.Environment.Name | ToLower}-artefacts`.

fields.label: Object key prefix
fields.help: Prefix prepended to each uploaded file's relative path. Trailing slash optional.

fields.label: File glob
fields.help: Glob selecting which files in the deployment package get uploaded. Defaults to everything.

fields.label: Access key ID (variable)
fields.help: Reference a sensitive variable that holds the AWS access key ID. Never hand-typed.

fields.label: Secret access key (variable)
fields.help: Reference a sensitive variable that holds the AWS secret access key. The value is encrypted at rest and never logged.

fields.label: Canned ACL
fields.help: Optional canned ACL applied to every uploaded object. Leave empty to inherit the bucket default.

fields.label: Continue on error
fields.help: When true, per-file failures are logged but don't fail the step. The artifact manifest carries a `partial: true` flag in that case.
